MUTATION LEDGER (AC8) — every pin in tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_backend_characterization.py
was mutation-checked: the pinned value was perturbed (one map entry, or one boundary by one
character) in the working tree, the pin was run, and the verdict confirmed to be an AssertionError
and not an AttributeError/ImportError (which would prove nothing). Gerrit change 1235.

MUTATED: LOCAL_PRIORITY_TO_JIRA[1] "High" -> "Higher"; FAILED: test_dc_create_path_maps_every_key_by_value, test_dc_create_path_priority_map_pins_every_level, test_dc_map_fields_to_remote_maps_every_priority_plus_unmapped_default
MUTATED: LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA["in_progress"] "In Progress" -> "In progress"; FAILED: test_dc_create_path_maps_every_key_by_value, test_dc_create_path_status_map_pins_every_state, test_dc_map_fields_to_remote_maps_every_status_plus_unmapped_default
MUTATED: JIRA_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS 254 -> 253; FAILED: test_dc_sanitize_summary_at_inclusive_limit_is_untruncated, test_dc_sanitize_summary_one_over_limit_truncates_with_marker
MUTATED: JIRA_LABEL_MAX_CHARS 255 -> 254; FAILED: test_dc_sanitize_label_pins_the_shared_token_rules

MUTATED: _map_local_to_dc_fields assignee ticket.get("assignee") or "" -> ticket.get("assignee", ""); FAILED: test_dc_create_path_coerces_explicit_none_to_empty_string
MUTATED: _map_local_to_dc_fields description codec.fit_outbound(...) -> unfitted passthrough; FAILED: test_dc_create_path_fits_description_through_the_wiki_codec, test_dc_create_path_description_fit_diverges_from_cloud
MUTATED: WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT 32767 -> 32766; FAILED: test_dc_rich_text_constants_pinned, test_dc_sanitize_description_at_inclusive_limit_is_untruncated, test_dc_sanitize_comment_at_inclusive_limit_is_untruncated, test_dc_map_fields_to_remote_leaves_an_at_limit_description_untouched, test_dc_create_path_leaves_an_at_limit_description_untouched
MUTATED: _WIKI_TRUNCATION_SUFFIX " ... [truncated by reconciler]" -> " ... [truncated by reconcilers]"; FAILED: test_dc_sanitize_description_one_over_limit_truncates_with_marker, test_dc_sanitize_comment_one_over_limit_truncates_with_marker, test_dc_create_path_fits_description_through_the_wiki_codec

MUTATED: OutboundFieldMapper status default "To Do" -> "Todo"; FAILED: test_dc_map_fields_to_remote_maps_every_status_plus_unmapped_default
MUTATED: JiraIdentityConvention _CANONICAL_PREFIX "rebar-id:" -> "rebar-id="; FAILED: test_dc_identity_format_label_uses_canonical_colon_form
MUTATED: classify_probe_response archived tuple (404, 410, 403) -> (404, 410); FAILED: test_dc_classify_probe_response_pins_every_branch
MUTATED: DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES frozenset({"Resolved","Done","Cancelled"}) -> frozenset({"Resolved","Done","Canceled"}); FAILED: test_dc_default_resolved_statuses_pinned, test_dc_classify_probe_response_pins_every_branch, test_dc_probe_binds_its_own_resolved_statuses_not_clouds
MUTATED: JiraDataCenterTransport.__init__ self._resolved_statuses = resolved_statuses -> = DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES; FAILED: test_dc_probe_binds_its_own_resolved_statuses_not_clouds

TWO MUTATIONS INITIALLY SURVIVED. Recorded because a ledger that lists only successes is not
evidence, and because both survivals were real defects in the pins, now fixed:

1. WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT 32767 -> 32766 SURVIVED on the first run: the at-limit pins built their
   inputs from the IMPORTED constant, so the mutation moved the test's own boundary along with the
   code's. A pin that reads its expectation out of the value it pins cannot fail. Fixed by pinning
   against a module-local LITERAL (WIKI_LIMIT = 32767) plus an explicit
   test_dc_rich_text_constants_pinned; the same mutation now kills five pins (the row above).

2. The mapper's isinstance(value, str) description guard could NOT be killed on its own, and neither
   could WikiTextCodec.fit_outbound's non-str early return: the two guards are REDUNDANT on the DC
   path (removing the mapper's leaves the codec guarding, and normalize_outbound is the identity;
   making the codec coerce leaves the mapper's branch short-circuiting before the codec is called).
   Only removing BOTH is observable, which is how the row above records it. The pin was also
   strengthened to assert object IDENTITY (is None / is sentinel_dict), since an == comparison would
   still pass against the string "None".

The mutations are applied and reverted in the working tree and leave no repo artifact, so the same
ledger is also committed as a module-level comment block in the test file (AC8's second record).
